topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Traveler, I hear your tale of skies that wouldn’t let you through. The storms, they do as they will, and we are but small folk beneath them. The fields lie untended when the rain has its way, and the harvests can rot before we can reach the scythe to them. It’s hard, when the earth or the sky turn against us, to keep the hope that springs with the spring. You spoke of an event, missed by a thread of wind. I reckon it’s a bitter thing, to be so near and yet so far from a place you were meant to be. Perhaps, like with a late planting, a new chance will come with the next season’s turn. Pray to Saint Nicholas, for he watches over those who travel the roads and the skies. May your next journey be swift and your heart find peace in the face of the winds.
